title: Many strands, one of them new
statement: Keep several strands of practice running across lessons, with only one bringing in new material while the rest review.
example: One lesson-writing workflow composes lessons as interleaved tracks at about 90:10 review to new.
detail: The direct-instruction rules a second-round review applied to the reading course say to keep multiple tracks alive over time, with only one introducing new material while the rest is review. The reading project's lesson-writing workflow builds this in, composing lessons as interleaved tracks at about 90:10 review to new.
against: A design rule, not a result: nothing here measured what the ratio does for learning, and the skill that uses it was unpromoted when it was recorded (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0123-teacher-g3-reading-candidate-skill.qmd`).
